name: episode_update
title: Update episode metadata
description: Updates the saved episode's own title, description, Episode-time chapters, and/or Episode date. Requires the Episode's draft_revision from episode_read; a stale token fails without overwriting newer human copy. Episode date is the durable project chronology field; date-only input is interpreted as 12:00 UTC and sets the basis to manual. This is metadata-only; structural timeline edits use the separate episode_edit patch primitive. It changes the episode itself; YouTube/LinkedIn/X package copy belongs to publish_prepare and publish_update.

chapters.description: Optional user-authored Episode-time chapters. Omitted preserves the current field; [] clears it.

start_seconds.description: Chapter start on the playable Episode clock.

episode_date.description: Optional ISO8601 date or timestamp for the Episode date. Date-only values are stored at 12:00 UTC.

expected_revision.description: Required opaque draft_revision from a fresh episode_read or binding receipt. A stale token is rejected before any metadata write.

draft_revision.description: Authoritative opaque draft revision after the metadata write.
